blocks.text: Derived (associated) lipids simple aur compound lipids ki hydrolysis ke products hain jo lipids ki khasiyatein rakhte hain, maslan fatty acids, glycerol, steroids, lipid mein ghulne wale vitamins aur terpenes. Yeh khud charbi nahi balke charbi se aate hain, aur tawanai aur hormones ki tayyari, cell ki banawat, asab ki sehat aur vitamins ke kaam mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain.

Steroids fatty acids se nahi bante lekin un mein lipids jaisi kuch khasiyatein hain. In mein teen cyclohexane rings aur aik cyclopentane ring aapas mein jure hote hain, steroid nucleus; rings ko A, B, C aur D kaha jata hai. Bohat se steroids mein -OH group bhi hota hai, jo unhein alcohol ki qism (sterols) mein dalta hai. Jaandaar nizamon mein bohat se steroids hain, jin mein cholesterol, bile salts, vitamin D aur steroid hormones shamil hain. Cholesterol woh khaam maal hai jis se jism steroid hormones banata hai, aur kuch hormones amino acids se bante hain.

blocks.alt: Steroid nucleus: teen chhe rukni rings A, B aur C aur aik paanch rukni ring D aapas mein jure, A/B ke jor aur C/D ke jor par CH3 group, aur ring D par R.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.12: Steroid ki rings ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 27.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Paudon mein terpenes kehlane wale hydrocarbons ki wasee variety hai, jo isoprene units se bante hain (isoprene 2-methylbuta-1,3-diene, CH2=C(CH3)-CH=CH2, hai). In hydrocarbons aur un ke oxygen wale derivatives mein 40 se kam carbon atoms hote hain; 40 carbon atoms wale terpenes carotenoids kehlate hain. Lemon mein milne wala limonene aik terpene hai.

blocks.alt: Limonene ki skeletal banawat: chhe rukni halqa jis mein aik C=C double bond aur double bond wale carbon par methyl group; saamne wale ring carbon se hashed bond aik carbon tak jata hai jis par methyl group aur =CH2 group hain. Label: limonene (a terpene).
blocks.caption: Limonene (aik terpene) (topic 27.4.4 ke saath chhapi banawat ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Limonene mein 10 carbon atoms hain, yani do isoprene units (har aik 5 carbon). Halqe mein aik C=C hai aur bahar wale group mein doosra C=C (=CH2).

blocks.prompt: Steroid nucleus ke chaar rings aur un ke size batayein.
blocks.explanation: A, B aur C chhe rukni (cyclohexane) rings aur D paanch rukni (cyclopentane) ring hai.

items: Derived lipids: fatty acids, glycerol, steroids, lipid mein ghulne wale vitamins, terpenes.
Steroid nucleus: teen chhe rukni + aik paanch rukni ring (cholesterol, bile salts, vitamin D, hormones).
Terpenes: isoprene units se (limonene); C40 terpenes carotenoids.
